title: Reptile Thermostat Hot-Side Stability
dataSources: Apex controller readings (`apex:reading`), Seneye measurements (`seneye:reading`), reptile thermostat events (`reptilethermostat:event`), and misting-system cycles (`mister:cycle`).
app: Aquarium and terrarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, Seneye, reptile thermostats, and misting systems sent to Splunk HEC via controller APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reptilethermostat:event
| search hot_side_delta_c=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(hot_side_delta_c) as avg_hot_side_delta_c max(hot_side_delta_c) as max_hot_side_delta_c by _time enclosure_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks hot-side temperature stability over time and breaks it out by enclosure.
value: Hot-side stability is a core husbandry check, especially for species that depend on a reliable basking gradient.
implementation: Send hot-side temperature stability events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of hot-side temperature stability by enclosure.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how hot-side temperature stability changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
